title: Folding V-gauge
summary: A 3D-printed tool that measures cylinder diameters: diameter = N × slider reading.
description: Two arms form a V that locks at one of four angles (×1, ×2, ×5, ×10). A slider pushed up through the apex touches the object, and you multiply its reading by the setting. Folded to 0°, it becomes a 100 mm ruler. Each angle is set so that sin a = N/(N+2), which makes the diameter exactly N times the slider reading. The geometry is generated from a parametric Python script, and a fit-test print tunes the clearances.
highlights: Measures 13–322 mm diameters across four settings
Snap pins and index pegs, with no bolts or other hardware
Clearances tuned with a printed fit test (0.15–0.45 mm)
